security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.longDescription: Write one entry per day. Entries are plain Markdown files in a folder you choose, with mood, tags, search, calendar, streaks and a year-in-review heatmap.
